name: 黄铜螺帽
original: 资料/历史/图标原图/黄铜螺帽.png
intended_use: 古铜之拳的临时力量状态图标
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: tiny pixel-art status icon for the Slay the Spire 2 character mod PunchConstruct, for an ancient relic's temporary Strength buff.
Primary request: ONE brass hexagonal nut, thick, squat, slightly rounded bevels, seen in a simple shallow three-quarter top view. Clearly recognizable dark hollow circular threaded hole at its center, a small dark lower front face to indicate thickness. Only the nut, no bolt, no screw, no other objects.
Style/medium: authentic coarse 32 by 32 pixel sprite design shown enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor square pixels. Match the simplicity of the small provided workshop status icon: hand-placed chunky pixel clusters, dark charcoal outline 1 logical pixel wide, 6 to 8 opaque colors total, very simple shading. It must remain readable at 32px and 24px in-game. Do not draw hundreds of tiny details.
Composition/framing: centered isolated single nut occupying about 82 percent of the square canvas, balanced small transparent margins on every side. Broad hexagonal silhouette, broad clear hole about one third the object's width, 3 or 4 large flat shaded facets. Slightly softened corners through pixel steps, sturdy and attractive.
Color palette: muted warm yellow brass with ochre midtones, dark brown shadows and one restrained pale cream highlight on the upper left bevel. Brass yellow, not orange copper. Clearly separated light top and darker front faces.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, including the empty hole through the nut. No background, no ground or cast shadow outside the silhouette.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D render, smooth glossy gradients, glow, sparkles, rays, spark particles, motion swooshes, embellishment, scratch clutter, excessive weathering, pedestal, circular badge, frame, letters, numbers, watermark. Output just this one sprite, not a sprite sheet, mockup, grid or comparison.
size64: 资料/美术素材/状态图标/黄铜螺帽.png
conversion: alpha>16 crop, fit 28px in 32px, nearest 2x, 56px visible extent
